metadata.method: 逐条完整阅读、开放编码、持续比较、逐条人工 assignment；程序仅转换格式并验证。
metadata.independence: 本轮未读取或复用其他轮次的 codebook、assignment、memo 或参考标签。
metadata.limits: 单一 AI 编码；机械一致性检查不构成人工双重编码或语义准确性证明。

codes.name: Missing or expanded functionality
codes.definition: A capability, operation, integration, data path, model component, or supported scenario is absent, incomplete, or explicitly planned for implementation/extension.
codes.inclusion_criteria: “implement …”, unsupported backbones/types/operations, unfinished functionality, missing integrations.
codes.exclusion_criteria: a capability exists but behaves incorrectly (`SATD02`); only tests are missing (`SATD04`); the request is solely to expose an existing choice as configuration (`SATD09`).

representative_evidence.interpretation: 拼接前反转bw是未完成步骤，也暗示当前处理顺序不符合预期。

codes.name: Known correctness defect
codes.definition: The artifact reports behavior known or strongly asserted to be wrong, inconsistent with an expected result, or already failing.
codes.inclusion_criteria: wrong results, ignored required values, off-by-one errors, broken behavior, explicit fixes to known faults.
codes.exclusion_criteria: a possible defect still requiring investigation (`SATD18`); unsupported inputs without an observed wrong result (`SATD03`); numerical overflow/precision mechanisms (`SATD17`, optionally also this code when failure is explicit).

representative_evidence.interpretation: 拼接前反转bw是未完成步骤，也暗示当前处理顺序不符合预期。

codes.name: Input, type, shape, or boundary coverage
codes.definition: The implementation does not cover a class of inputs, data types, shapes, formats, values, or boundary conditions.
codes.inclusion_criteria: `None`, strings, tuples, dictionaries, short names, multiple speakers, dynamic shapes, empty/zero/singleton cases, unsupported file/data variants.
codes.exclusion_criteria: a wholly new domain capability (`SATD01`); validation or recovery is the central issue (`SATD14`); only test coverage is missing (`SATD04`).

representative_evidence.interpretation: 当前US表示在某些数值范围下容量不足，既是边界规模覆盖限制，也是数值表示范围问题。

codes.name: Testing or verification debt
codes.definition: Automated tests, assertions, validation experiments, coverage, or confirmation of correctness are absent or insufficient.
codes.inclusion_criteria: untested code, missing test cases, weak assertions, requests to verify whether behavior works, hardware-dependent tests that cannot run broadly.
codes.exclusion_criteria: runtime input validation (`SATD14`); diagnostic logging (`SATD15`); an already confirmed implementation defect (`SATD02`) unless missing regression coverage is also explicit.

representative_evidence.interpretation: 数学测试存在未说明目标环境的兼容问题，兼具测试覆盖与依赖/后端兼容债务。

codes.name: Documentation, example, or user guidance debt
codes.definition: Explanations, API documentation, tutorials, examples, comments, user-facing instructions, or source references are missing, incomplete, or misleading.
codes.inclusion_criteria: placeholder docs, incomplete download instructions, examples needing replacement, missing provenance references.
codes.exclusion_criteria: runtime error messages or logs (`SATD15`); uncertainty internal to the implementer (`SATD18`); packaging metadata (`SATD19`).

representative_evidence.interpretation: 现有phantom生成能力尚未转化为教程，债务位于用户教育材料。

codes.name: Performance or resource-efficiency debt
codes.definition: Runtime, memory, I/O, algorithmic complexity, redundant computation, copying, loading, or resource use is known or suspected to be inefficient.
codes.inclusion_criteria: slow loops, O(N²) work, excessive memory, eager loading, unnecessary full-distribution computation, repeated caching, GPU utilization for efficiency.
codes.exclusion_criteria: parallel/distributed capability is itself the central missing mechanism (`SATD16`, which may co-occur); numerical correctness (`SATD17`); general code elegance without an efficiency claim (`SATD12`).
codes.boundary_examples: `23shades-0733-aajacfjii`, O(N²) behavior that may be too slow for large graphs.

representative_evidence.interpretation: unparser只覆盖有限AST节点，同时考虑迁移到更快的_ast表示；功能、性能和Python AST依赖迁移均明确，但方案仍未确定。

codes.name: Architecture, modularity, or responsibility refactoring
codes.definition: Component boundaries, dependency direction, module ownership, lifecycle structure, duplication, or separation of responsibilities requires redesign or refactoring.
codes.inclusion_criteria: circular dependencies, moving logic to another module, extracting functions, breaking up modules, de-duplicating implementations, separating functional and stateful layers.
codes.exclusion_criteria: local readability/style cleanup (`SATD12`); public parameter/name/return-contract changes (`SATD08`); simple removal of obsolete code (`SATD11`).

representative_evidence.quote: Functions used by more than one algorithm
representative_evidence.interpretation: 共享算法函数的组织被明确标为以后妥善重构，核心是跨算法工具的模块与职责边界。

codes.name: API, contract, naming, or behavioral-design debt
codes.definition: A callable interface, return structure, lifecycle hook, ownership rule, naming convention, data-model contract, or externally visible behavior is unclear, inconsistent, or needs redesign.
codes.inclusion_criteria: renaming parameters/modules, changing return types, deciding in-place semantics, correcting responsibility in a functional API, standardizing field names.
codes.exclusion_criteria: adding a configuration knob to vary an otherwise clear behavior (`SATD09`); internal module decomposition (`SATD07`); unsupported data variants (`SATD03`).
codes.boundary_examples: `23shades-0575-aaejcccgj`, a functional API should not instantiate an `nn.Module`.

representative_evidence.interpretation: name/index/uuid等标识设计可能重写，涉及数据/API契约，但语气表明方案尚未确定。

codes.name: Configuration, defaults, or flexibility debt
codes.definition: A hard-coded choice should be configurable, a default is absent/arbitrary/questionable, or callers need control over an existing behavior.
codes.inclusion_criteria: configurable dtype, optional reshape/copy, default monitors, magic values that should come from data/configuration, arbitrary sample counts.
codes.exclusion_criteria: unsupported input types (`SATD03`); a new capability rather than control over an existing one (`SATD01`); a naming/return-contract change (`SATD08`).

representative_evidence.interpretation: name为None时应使用functionality.__name__补充默认名称，属于明确默认行为缺口。

codes.name: Compatibility, dependency, version, or external-workaround debt
codes.definition: Code is constrained by, adapting to, or temporarily working around an external library, platform, protocol, repository, model version, or backward-compatibility requirement.
codes.inclusion_criteria: dependency-version workarounds, upstream issues, Python-version compatibility, API migrations, behavior retained until an external capability arrives, cross-repository coordinated changes.
codes.exclusion_criteria: internal deprecation with no external/version condition (`SATD11`); build/package declarations (`SATD19`); concurrency limitations (`SATD16`).
codes.boundary_examples: `23shades-0586-aagdaagij`, temporary preprocessing retained until InceptionResNetV2 is retrained.

representative_evidence.interpretation: SVG居中依赖针对失效justify-content的外部布局workaround，且被作者明确称为hack。

codes.name: Cleanup, removal, deprecation, or dead-code debt
codes.definition: Obsolete, redundant, unused, temporary, debug, compatibility, or deprecated material is explicitly slated for removal or retirement.
codes.inclusion_criteria: version-scheduled deletion, dead-code candidates, removing debug tasks, cleanup after an experiment or migration.
codes.exclusion_criteria: replacing a flawed architecture while preserving functionality (`SATD07`); deletion whose purpose is only guessed from an underspecified “remove” (`SATD20` also applies); upstream/version compatibility conditions (`SATD10` may co-occur).

representative_evidence.interpretation: 仅供测试的nrows混入一般实现，需要隔离职责并清理测试专用接口。

codes.name: Maintainability, readability, or local code-quality debt
codes.definition: The admitted problem is local clarity, complexity, style, duplication at a small scale, formatting, elegance, or maintainability without a more specific architectural or functional claim.
codes.inclusion_criteria: ugly/dense/confusing code, “make nicer,” local cleanup, prettier implementation, unexplained hacks when maintainability is explicit.
codes.exclusion_criteria: module/dependency restructuring (`SATD07`); performance claims (`SATD06`); an artifact too vague to identify even local code quality (`SATD20`).
codes.boundary_examples: `23shades-0742-aahedhicb`, dense and confusing code needing cleanup.

representative_evidence.quote: An empty dictionary would actually also do here
representative_evidence.interpretation: 作者认为当前数据结构可用更简单的空字典替代，属于局部清理；但理由在句中截断，保留证据不足。

codes.name: Algorithm, model, data, or result-quality debt
codes.definition: The selected algorithm, learned-model behavior, data quality, heuristic, metric, training strategy, or result quality is inadequate or requires improvement/selection.
codes.inclusion_criteria: poor model results, questionable hard-example mining, arbitrary heuristics, incomplete training labels, method/backend selection based on quality.
codes.exclusion_criteria: purely computational efficiency (`SATD06`); numerical overflow/precision (`SATD17`); ordinary implementation correctness (`SATD02`).
codes.boundary_examples: `23shades-0559-aafdibbge`, inability to obtain good results with the current approach.

representative_evidence.interpretation: 绘图示例需换成faithful dataset，核心是示例数据的代表性与结果展示质量。

codes.name: Robustness, validation, error handling, or recovery debt
codes.definition: The implementation lacks input/state validation, safe failure, useful exception behavior, retry/backoff, recovery, or defensive handling of runtime hazards.
codes.inclusion_criteria: divide-by-zero protection, more specific exceptions, malformed-input prevention, HTTP 429 backoff, defensive copies, validation before an invalid operation.
codes.exclusion_criteria: testing that validation works (`SATD04`); logging only (`SATD15`); unsupported but otherwise valid input kinds (`SATD03`).
codes.boundary_examples: `23shades-0596-aagbdjhgb`, making a calculation safe against division by zero.

representative_evidence.interpretation: 参数组合兼容检查尚未实现，运行前验证不足。

codes.name: Observability, logging, diagnostics, or provenance debt
codes.definition: Runtime events, timing, failures, origins, or state are insufficiently logged, messaged, measured, or traceable.
codes.inclusion_criteria: missing log messages/levels, weak error diagnostics, timing instrumentation, source provenance, clearer user-facing failure context.
codes.exclusion_criteria: general documentation (`SATD05`); test assertions (`SATD04`); algorithm metrics used to improve model quality (`SATD13`).

representative_evidence.interpretation: 缺失的上游confidence被硬编码为1，形成不真实默认值并损害置信度来源可追踪性。

codes.name: Concurrency, parallelism, distribution, or device-scaling debt
codes.definition: Work cannot safely or efficiently execute across threads, processes, workers, devices, batches, or distributed partitions, or lacks the mechanisms to do so.
codes.inclusion_criteria: parallelization, GPU/multi-GPU handling, multi-thread safety, distributed state transfer, load rebalancing, batched/distributed execution.
codes.exclusion_criteria: performance without a concurrency mechanism (`SATD06`); ordinary blocking calls without a stated concurrency design (`SATD06` or `SATD14` as supported); external device-library compatibility (`SATD10`, optionally co-coded).

representative_evidence.quote: future enhancement TODO for running on multiple GPU
representative_evidence.interpretation: 多GPU运行是明确的未来功能增强，并涉及设备并行扩展。

codes.name: Numerical precision, stability, or mathematical-representation debt
codes.definition: Floating-point stability, overflow/underflow, precision, scaling, mathematical-domain representation, or numerically safe formulation is inadequate or uncertain.
codes.inclusion_criteria: precision overflow, log-density versus density, unsafe numerical scaling, unexplained low digits of accuracy.
codes.exclusion_criteria: general wrong logic (`SATD02`); divide-by-zero as a defensive runtime boundary (`SATD14`, unless a broader stability formulation is explicit); tensor shape/type coverage (`SATD03`).

representative_evidence.interpretation: 当前US表示在某些数值范围下容量不足，既是边界规模覆盖限制，也是数值表示范围问题。

codes.name: Investigation, uncertainty, rationale, or design-choice debt
codes.definition: The artifact records an unresolved question, unknown cause, uncertain correctness, unclear rationale, technology choice, or need for investigation rather than a settled implementation action.
codes.inclusion_criteria: “why does this happen?”, “is this needed?”, competing design options, uncertain API behavior, root-cause research, knowledge gaps.
codes.exclusion_criteria: a confirmed defect with a clear action (`SATD02`); an artifact so short that even the question/object is unavailable (`SATD20`); a defined algorithm-quality experiment (`SATD13`, possibly co-coded).
codes.boundary_examples: `23shades-0841-aagcbggid`, uncertainty about which implementation direction is best.

representative_evidence.interpretation: 当前解析方案被认为hacky，计划改用regex或其他办法；具体替代仍未决定。

codes.name: Build, packaging, deployment, or operational-infrastructure debt
codes.definition: Installation metadata, dependency declarations, archive/build outputs, deployment configuration, artifact release, data acquisition infrastructure, or operational setup is incomplete or needs change.
codes.inclusion_criteria: missing package requirements, archive-format changes, release integrity configuration, build/deployment environment setup.
codes.exclusion_criteria: runtime library compatibility (`SATD10`); application-level configuration (`SATD09`); model checkpoint semantics (`SATD08` or `SATD01` unless the issue is release infrastructure).

representative_evidence.interpretation: 明确是20.07发布前的代码格式清理，包含局部可维护性与发布准备维度。

codes.name: Insufficiently specified or non-actionable evidence
codes.definition: The artifact does not contain enough information to determine a substantive debt category or identify the object/action with defensible specificity.
codes.inclusion_criteria: empty/bare TODOs, “fix this later,” “U,” truncated fragments whose missing portion contains the needed object, comments that merely explain behavior without admitting a defect or improvement.
codes.exclusion_criteria: short comments that nevertheless name a clear action and object, such as “Implement Conv Transpose” (`SATD01`); uncertainty with an identifiable subject (`SATD18`).
codes.boundary_examples: `23shades-0752-aagfegjcg`, the complete admitted comment is only “TODO: U.”

representative_evidence.interpretation: 完整材料只有无对象的!TODO，无法防御性地判断具体债务内容。
